critical_write_rule: A WPVibe write returning 429 must be treated as UNKNOWN, not failed/not-run. Page272 af2e0007 proved that a content/edit returned 429 while the mutation later appeared in exact hash/fragment readback. Never blindly retry such a write.
safe_operating_policy: Do not spam site calls while the throttle is active; a nominal single call can consume three automatic retries.
Keep the 10-call D11 recovery reserve intact.
Before any next write, perform one combined bytes/SHA/JSON plus fragment-state readback on the affected resource.
Do not change WordPress security, WAF, Cloudflare or host configuration without direct proof that that layer owns the limit.

If the operator can configure the edge layer, prefer an allow/skip rule scoped to the target host plus X-WPVibe: 1 or User-Agent WPVibe/1.0 rather than IP allowlisting, because relay source IPs may rotate.
